question: Should OpenClaw permanently support account-level Signal `apiMode` overrides while treating native daemon reachability and container linked-account/receive readiness as intentionally different setup contracts?
rationale: The branch introduces a durable configuration capability and asymmetric readiness semantics; implementation tests cannot decide the user-facing upgrade and support policy.

options.title: Accept the expanded contract
options.body: Keep channel-level `apiMode` as the default, allow account overrides, and document the distinct native and container readiness guarantees.

options.title: Land a narrower wizard
options.body: Remove account-level `apiMode` overrides and keep the setup wizard within the existing channel-global transport contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the wizard until one uniform readiness guarantee can be provided across both transports.

recommendation.title: Accept the expanded contract
recommendation.body: Keep channel-level `apiMode` as the default, allow account overrides, and document the distinct native and container readiness guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged history spans Signal setup, Plugin SDK boundaries, and API-mode compatibility behavior.
